patterns.note: Card-based listings are used for the 'TOP 10 WEBSITE' section, each featuring a logo, star rating, descriptive text, and two distinct call-to-action buttons.
An accordion pattern is consistently applied for the FAQ section, allowing users to expand and collapse answers with a clear chevron indicator.

A deep maroon/dark red (#b20000) is used as a dominant accent color for the sticky header background and key navigational elements, contrasting with vibrant green (#7a9c59) and orange-red (#d26e4b) for call-to-action buttons.
The initial multi-level header (top bar and main navigation) collapses and transforms into a single, compact, dark-themed sticky navigation bar upon scrolling down the page.
A decorative script font is exclusively reserved for the main brand logo, while all other textual content, including headings and body, utilizes a clean, modern sans-serif font.

technique_notes: The sticky header effect involves two initial header rows (a top utility bar and a main navigation bar) that, upon scroll, collapse into a single, compact fixed navigation bar. This bar adopts a solid, dark background color and adjusts font sizes and colors for readability against the new background, likely using css-keyframes for the transition.
Content sections are clearly delineated by full-width background colors or subtle borders, with main content contained within a fixed-width central column for readability.
Interactive elements like call-to-action buttons use distinct, high-contrast background colors (green and orange-red) to draw attention, with a subtle rounded corner and white text.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are bold and significantly larger than body text, establishing a clear hierarchy, while body text maintains good legibility and spacing.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density, with comfortable padding around content blocks and within card elements, and generous vertical spacing between major sections.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the dramatic transformation of the multi-level header into a single, compact, dark-themed sticky navigation bar upon scroll, which effectively reclaims screen space while maintaining navigation access. The exclusive use of a decorative script font for the brand logo, contrasted with a functional sans-serif for all other content, also creates a unique brand identity.
